scope: Controlled local paired benchmark with independent correctness checks; not official scoring or submission

workload_capture.scope: Mock transport compares SQL text only. It does not execute SQL and is not database correctness evidence.

high_cardinality_scope.note: Three alternating pairs per selected schema at a common completed size; boundary expansion is a separate diagnostic, not repeated OOM attempts.

cache_note: Fresh process and independent data directory per variant/run; no global drop_caches. First read is process-first, not OS-cold.

oracle.storage_and_query_quantization: IEEE-754 binary32, then promoted to binary64
oracle.distance: sqrt(sum((stored - query)^2, dtype=float64)); exhaustive eligible-record scan
oracle.location: Driver process outside database cgroup; computed before all measured runs
